name: CpuFindFairwaySpot

name: NextAimOffset

name: NextAimOffsetFine

comment: bc = distance: shortest club (from 1W down) that still reaches it on this lie (CpuClubDistanceForLie); skips banned clubs; putter on the green; woods only from tee/fairway ($00 $0E) else club 3

name: CpuClubDistanceForLie

name: CpuClubDistanceAtPower

name: CpuPowerForDistance
comment: bc = club distance de = wanted distance: power (de + $60) x 60 / bc capped at $3C; $3C when the club is short

name: CpuLandingPoint
comment: a = club h = power e (power) bc = aim: ball + polar(CpuClubDistanceAtPower) -> bc = x de = y

name: CpuShortenToGoodLie

name: CpuFindClearAim

name: CpuWindAdjustClubPower

name: WindCarryLookup
